variants.label: Car music
variants.opening: Someone is blasting music from a car in front of my building and it will not stop.
variants.nature: A group of guys are hanging out around a car with the speakers cranked up.
variants.weapons: I did not see any weapons.
variants.suspect: A lowered grey hatchback, four or five guys, they are drinking.
variants.safety: I am in my apartment, I am fine.

variants.label: Power tools at midnight
variants.opening: My neighbor is running some kind of machine at midnight, it sounds like a saw and it will not stop.
variants.nature: Loud power tools and music from the garage, it has been going two hours.
variants.weapons: No.
variants.suspect: My neighbor, the man in the yellow house, I asked him to stop and he laughed.
variants.safety: I am safe inside.

variants.label: Party spilling into the street
variants.opening: The party next door spilled into the street and some guys are shoving each other.
variants.nature: A lot of people in the road, shouting, a couple of men pushing and cursing, bottles on the ground.
variants.weapons: None that I can see.
variants.suspect: Too many people, a few men in matching red shirts started it.
variants.safety: I am inside, my door is locked.

variants.label: Not a police matter
variants.behavior: Your complaint is only that a neighbor's dog barked for five minutes in the afternoon. You are irritated but will accept being told this is not something that needs officers.
variants.opening: My neighbor's dog is barking and I want an officer to come deal with it right now.
variants.nature: The dog barked for about five minutes while they were out. It is two in the afternoon.
variants.weapons: No weapons.
variants.injuries: No one is hurt, the dog is fine.
variants.suspect: It is the neighbor in the green house.
variants.safety: I am fine, just annoyed.

callers.name: Hal M.
callers.mood: calm and methodical, writing things down

variants.label: Car gone from the lot
variants.opening: My car was stolen, I parked it right here an hour ago and it is gone.
variants.nature: I parked a black sedan, came back and the spot is empty. There is glass on the ground.
variants.weapons: No weapons involved.
variants.suspect: I did not see who took it.
variants.safety: I am safe, standing in the parking lot.

variants.label: Truck taken while idling
variants.opening: Someone just drove off in my truck, I saw them take it!
variants.nature: A man jumped into my idling pickup while I ran inside and drove away.
variants.weapons: I did not see a weapon.
variants.suspect: Man in a white T shirt and a red cap, he went toward the highway.
variants.safety: I am fine, I am standing at the door.

variants.label: Window smashed in progress
variants.opening: I think someone is stealing my car right now, I can see them from my window!
variants.nature: Someone is breaking the window of my car and getting inside.
variants.weapons: I could not see anything in their hands.
variants.injuries: I am not hurt, I am upstairs.
variants.suspect: One person, grey sweatshirt, thin, looks like a young adult.
variants.safety: I am inside my apartment.

variants.label: Carjacking
variants.opening: A man just pulled me out of my car and drove off with it, he had a gun!
variants.nature: A man pointed a gun at me at the stoplight, made me get out and took my car.
variants.weapons: A black handgun.
variants.injuries: I fell and scraped my knee, I am fine otherwise.
variants.suspect: Man in a black hoodie and jeans, heading north in my silver sedan.
variants.safety: I am on the sidewalk, shaking, he is gone.

variants.label: Forgot where I parked
variants.behavior: Partway through the call you realise you parked on the next street over. Be sheepish, apologise and say nobody needs to come.
variants.opening: My car is gone, it was stolen, I parked right here.
variants.nature: I parked a red hatchback near the corner this morning and it is not here.
variants.weapons: No weapons.
variants.suspect: I did not see anyone.
variants.safety: I am fine.

variants.label: Light inside a closed building
variants.opening: There are people inside a building that has been closed all week.
variants.nature: I saw a flashlight moving around inside the old building and a door that is open.
variants.weapons: I did not see weapons.
variants.suspect: At least two people, I could not make out details.
variants.safety: I am outside at my truck, I will not go in.

variants.label: Armed man inside
variants.opening: There is a man with a gun walking around inside the warehouse, I can see him on the camera.
variants.nature: On the camera I can see a man with a pistol walking between the shelves, the side door was forced.
variants.weapons: A black handgun in his right hand.
variants.suspect: White male, medium build, black jacket and a ball cap, alone.
variants.safety: I am in a locked office away from him.

variants.label: Man will not leave the property
variants.opening: A man is on my property and will not leave, I told him twice.
variants.nature: A man hopped the fence and is sitting by my equipment. He says he is just looking around.
variants.weapons: None that I can see, he has a backpack.
variants.suspect: Man about forty, long beard, dirty brown jacket, backpack.
variants.safety: I am in my office with the door locked, he is about fifty feet away.

variants.label: Fence cut, truck inside
variants.opening: Somebody cut the fence at the site and drove in with a truck.
variants.nature: The gate chain has been cut and there is a pickup inside near the materials.
variants.weapons: I do not know.
variants.suspect: I only saw taillights, dark colored truck.
variants.safety: I am at the front gate, I am not going further.

variants.label: The contractor's crew
variants.behavior: If the dispatcher asks about any vehicles or logos, you notice the crew has company vests and a truck with a company logo, and the owner did mention a night crew. Say sorry and that nobody needs to come.
variants.opening: There are people on the closed site at night, I think they are trespassing.
variants.nature: A few people are working by lantern light near the back of the site.
variants.weapons: No weapons.
variants.suspect: Three workers in high visibility vests and a truck with a logo on the door.
variants.safety: I am at the gate, I am fine.

callers.name: Carla N.
callers.mood: uneasy, talking quietly from her house

variants.label: Trying car door handles
variants.opening: There is a man going down the street trying car door handles.
variants.nature: He pulls on each door handle, looks inside, and moves to the next car.
variants.weapons: I have not seen any weapons.
variants.suspect: Man in a green hoodie, jeans, carrying a backpack, about twenty five.
variants.safety: I am inside my house, watching.

variants.label: Man waving a gun
variants.opening: A man is walking down the street waving a pistol around!
variants.nature: He is walking in the road, holding a gun up and shouting at nobody.
variants.weapons: A pistol, I can see it clearly.
variants.suspect: Man in a blue jacket and shorts, he looks agitated, heading toward the main road.
variants.safety: I am inside with the blinds shut.

variants.label: Pacing outside a shop
variants.opening: A man has been standing outside my shop for an hour looking at the door, and he keeps pacing.
variants.nature: He is pacing, mumbling to himself and watching customers go in and out.
variants.weapons: His hands are in his pockets, I cannot tell.
variants.suspect: Tall, thin, grey jacket, a knit cap, he looks agitated.
variants.safety: I am behind the counter, the door is open.

variants.label: Looking in windows
variants.opening: Somebody is looking into people's windows on my street.
variants.nature: A person with a flashlight is going yard to yard and looking in windows.
variants.weapons: I did not see anything in their hands except the flashlight.
variants.suspect: Dark clothes, a hat. I could not see the face.
variants.safety: I turned off my lights and I am inside.

variants.label: Waiting for a ride
variants.behavior: If the dispatcher asks you to look again, a car with a rideshare sticker pulls up and the man gets in. Say sorry and that nobody needs to come.
variants.opening: There is a person standing in front of my house for twenty minutes and I do not know them.
variants.nature: A man stands on the sidewalk looking at his phone, and now and then at my house.
variants.weapons: None.
variants.suspect: Man in a black coat and a scarf, holding a phone.
variants.safety: I am inside.

callers.name: Walter J.
callers.mood: calm, a bit embarrassed to be stuck

callers.name: Becca L.
callers.mood: worried about being on a fast road

variants.label: Dead car on the shoulder
variants.opening: My car died on the highway and I am on the shoulder.
variants.nature: The engine cut out, I rolled onto the shoulder. Cars are passing fast.
variants.weapons: No weapons.
variants.injuries: I am okay, no one is hurt.
variants.suspect: No suspect, it is a breakdown.
variants.safety: I have my hazards on and I am standing behind the guardrail.

variants.label: Stalled in the lane, nobody inside
variants.opening: There is a stalled car in the middle of the road, nobody is in it and the lights are off.
variants.nature: A dark sedan stopped in the right lane, doors closed, hazards off. People are swerving around it.
variants.weapons: I do not see any.
variants.injuries: I do not see anyone, I do not know if the driver walked away.
variants.suspect: I did not see anyone around the car.
variants.safety: I am stopped a little way back with my flashers on.

variants.label: Debris in the road
variants.opening: There is a large piece of debris in the road, I almost hit it.
variants.nature: A big piece of a truck tire is lying across the lane, it is hard to see.
variants.weapons: No weapons.
variants.suspect: No one involved, I did not see a vehicle that lost it.
variants.safety: I am past it and pulled over, I am fine.

variants.label: Smoking truck blocking a lane
variants.opening: A truck is stopped in the middle lane with smoke coming from under the hood and people are swerving.
variants.nature: A white box truck stopped in the middle lane, smoke from the hood, hazards on.
variants.weapons: No weapons.
variants.injuries: The driver got out and he is standing by the guardrail, he looks fine.
variants.suspect: No suspect.
variants.safety: I am a hundred feet back with my flashers on.

variants.label: Tow already on the way
variants.behavior: You already called a tow truck and it is on the way, you are parked well off the road. You only call to check whether police need to come, and you accept that they do not.
variants.opening: My car broke down on the shoulder but a tow truck is already on the way.
variants.nature: I am parked well off the road with my hazards on, the tow company said twenty minutes.
variants.weapons: No weapons.
variants.suspect: No suspect.
variants.safety: I am fine, I am well off the roadway.
